fee_structure.payment_terms: Licence Charges: annual, invoiced annually in advance (pro-rated monthly for Initial Term). Data Charges: monthly, invoiced monthly in arrears.
fee_structure.late_penalty: Bank of England base rate plus 8% per annum, accrued daily on overdue amounts.
fee_structure.escalation: Exchanges reserve the right to amend Charges at their sole discretion in accordance with the Terms.
fee_structure.tax: All Charges exclude VAT. Customer responsible for all applicable taxes.
fee_structure.unit_of_count: Charges apply per Customer, per Unit of Count, per Data Product, on a cumulative basis. Units of count include: per Device (display), per application (non-display), per End Customer (derived data / historical redistribution), per Website (delayed/per price request), enterprise.
fee_structure.reporting_requirements: Data Charges reported in accordance with Reporting and Audit Schedule (Schedule C). Member locations must be pre-registered 21 days in advance.

Schedule A – Price List and Data Products

. This Schedule sets out the Data Products which are available for licensing and/or receipt, and the applicable Charges. Clause 3 below
sets out the Price List, and clause 4 sets out the Data Products available for licensing/receipt. For additional information on how the

. Please refer to the Terms, Order Form and the other Schedules for other defined terms used in this Schedule but not defined herein.

. Charges as listed in clause 3 of this Schedule apply per Customer, per Unit of Count, per Data Product applicable to the scope of use,
and on a cumulative basis. Policy details and definitions in respect of Charges are available in the Market Data Policy Schedule, and as
updated by the Exchanges from time to time in accordance with the Terms.

. All Charges exclude VAT and are in UK sterling as denoted. Licence Charges quoted are annual and invoiced annually in advance
unless approved in writing by the Exchanges. Licence Charges are pro-rated monthly for the Initial Term.
. Data Charges quoted are monthly unless otherwise stated. Data Charges are invoiced monthly in arrears.
. Any fee waivers are until further notice, unless otherwise specified.
. The Exchanges reserve the right to amend any Charges at their sole discretion in accordance with the Terms.

London Stock Exchange Market Data Products and Price List

. The Exchanges publish various Data, made available to Customers either through direct feeds/services, or indirectly through
Redistributors. The Data published is arranged into Data Products, which can be subscribed to or licensed directly with either Exchange
or indirectly with a Redistributor.

. The Data Products made available are as follows:
DATA PRODUCT
DESCRIPTION
AIM
means Data published relevant to securities traded on AIM, the LSE market for small and medium size
growth companies.
The AIM Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative uncrossing
volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP, cumulative
volumes, uncrossing price and volume.
Analytics Service
means Data calculated and published by the Exchanges, providing certain value-add analytics relating to
instruments traded on LSE and Turquoise venues, including but not limited to orderbook analytics.
ETF / ETP
means Data published relevant to certain instruments traded on the UK markets, namely exchange traded
funds (ETFs) and other exchange traded products (ETPs).
The ETF / ETP Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative
uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP,
cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume.
European market Data
means Data published relevant to securities traded on the European Quoting Service (EQS), a quote-
driven market making and trade reporting platform for liquid equity and equity-like securities.
The European market Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative
uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP,
cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume (including Data from the SI quoting service for the
relevant securities).
International market
Data
means Data published relevant to securities traded on the LSE international order book (IOB), consisting
of global depositary receipts (GDRs) from over 30 countries, including European market Data.
The International market Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative
uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP,
cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume (including Data from the SI quoting service for the
relevant securities).
Order Book for Retail
Bonds
means Data relating to the Order Book for Retail Bonds (ORB), consisting of UK gilts and UK corporate
bonds.
The Order Book for Retail Bonds content includes best price and volume, value traded per security,
indicative uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all
trades VWAP, cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume.
TRADEcho
means Data relating to TRADEcho, consisting of off-book on-exchange trade reports, systematic
internaliser trade reports and OTC trade reports.
The TRADEcho Data content for the SI quoting service includes pre-trade Data, and content for the trade
reporting activities includes individual trades, number of trades, cumulative volumes for ESMA FIRDS
instruments.
Turquoise Europe
market Data
means Data published relevant to securities traded on Turquoise Europe, a multilateral trading facility
(“MTF”) operated by Turquoise Global Holdings Europe B.V. (TGHE), with instruments available for trading
from a multitude of countries.
The Turquoise Europe market Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security,
indicative uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all
trades VWAP, cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume.
Turquoise market Data
means (i) Turquoise Europe market Data, and (ii) Data published relevant to securities traded on
Turquoise, a multilateral trading facility (“MTF”) operated by Turquoise Global Holdings Limited (TGHL)
with instruments available for trading from a multitude of countries.
The Turquoise market Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative
uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP,
cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume.
UK market Data
means Data published relevant to securities traded on the LSE UK order books, SETS, SETSqx and
SEAQ (including AIM, ETF / ETP, Order Book for Retail Bonds Data and Data from the SI quoting service
for the relevant securities).
London Stock Exchange Market Data Products and Price List

The UK market Data content includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative
uncrossing volume, opening prices, trade high and low, individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP,
cumulative volumes, uncrossing price and volume.

. The Data Products are available at various levels of depth:
LEVEL OF DATA
DESCRIPTION
Level 2
includes full depth of the book with all quotes, orders and Level 1 Data including trades, open price, close
price, uncrossing price plus volume, best price plus volume.
Level 1
includes best price and volume, value traded per security, indicative uncrossing volume, opening prices,
trade high and low individual trades, closing prices, all trades VWAP, cumulative volumes, uncrossing
price and volume, Post-trade Data.
Post-trade Data
includes on-book, on-exchange trade reports and TRADEcho SI quoting for the respective market.

. Where the Customer elects to receive Real Time Data directly from Exchange systems, permissions will be granted to the relevant
